---
title: Content
---

This section contains the core reading and slides for each week. Before coming to class, work through the relevant chapter(s) from the textbook and review any slides provided.

The main textbook for this course is [**R for Non-Programmers**](https://r4np.com){target="_blank"} by Daniel Dauber — a free, openly available online book written specifically for social science students with no prior programming experience.

::: {.callout-tip}
### How to use this section

1. **Read** the assigned r4np chapter(s) before the lesson
2. **Review** the slides if available
3. **Then** work through the interactive lesson and videos for the week
:::
